'''Orondia Tours''' was a tourism company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The company's logo was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a [[Color|pink]], blue, purple and white sign.<ref name="FAE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe.|Friends and Enemies Trivia Gallery|<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>}}
Orondia Tours was first mentioned on a sign that appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]]."<ref name="FAE" />
